content: To identify new keywords in the selected microposts, we again leverage crowdsourcing, as humans are typically better than machines at providing specific explanations BIBREF18, BIBREF19. In the crowdsourcing task, workers are first asked to find those microposts where the model predictions are deemed correct. Then, from those microposts, workers are asked to find the keyword that best indicates the class of the microposts as predicted by the model. The keyword most frequently identified by the workers is then used as the initial keyword for the following iteration. In case multiple keywords are selected, e.g., the top-$N$ frequent ones, workers will be asked to perform $N$ micropost classification tasks for each keyword in the next iteration, and the model training will be performed on multiple keyword-specific expectations.
